However, it avoided the potentially higher cost of opening/closing multiple containers if the item had been in a cabinet. Compared to the established memory's note that semantic prioritization (fridge) failed when the fridge was empty, this open-surface approach succeeded but with a high step count due to the specific layout where the target was on the last open surface checked.
